approved_steps.step: 1. Launch the URL https://e1euut.aws.baxter.com/jde/E1Menu.maf in the browser.
approved_steps.expected: The JD Edwards SSO login page is displayed.

approved_steps.step: 2. Enter the SSO Username in the username field.
approved_steps.expected: The SSO username is entered in the username field.

approved_steps.step: 3. Click the Next button.
approved_steps.expected: The page advances to the password entry step.
approved_steps.element_hint: Next button on SSO login page

approved_steps.step: 4. Enter the SSO Password in the password field.
approved_steps.expected: The SSO password is entered in the password field.

approved_steps.step: 5. Click the Sign in button.
approved_steps.expected: Authentication is initiated and the MFA or confirmation prompt is displayed.
approved_steps.element_hint: Sign in button on SSO login page

approved_steps.step: 6. Click the Yes button on the Stay signed in prompt.
approved_steps.expected: The JD Edwards home screen (E1Menu) is displayed.
approved_steps.element_hint: Yes button on Stay signed in dialog

approved_steps.step: 7. Wait for 10 seconds for the JD Edwards home page to fully load.
approved_steps.expected: The JD Edwards home page is fully loaded with the Navigator menu visible.

approved_steps.step: 8. Click the Navigator menu item (el-23).
approved_steps.expected: The Navigator panel expands showing available menu groups including Baxter GM View.

approved_steps.step: 9. Click on Baxter GM View (el-60).
approved_steps.expected: The Baxter GM View menu group expands showing sub-menus including Sales.

approved_steps.step: 10. Click on Sales (el-173).
approved_steps.expected: The Sales sub-menu expands showing options including Sales Order Entry.

approved_steps.step: 11. Click on Sales Order Entry (el-341).
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order Entry sub-menu expands showing order type options including Standard Order SO.

approved_steps.step: 12. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sales Order Entry menu to fully render.
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order Entry options are fully visible.

approved_steps.step: 13. Click on Standard Order SO (el-552).
approved_steps.expected: The Standard Order SO - Customer Service Inquiry screen is displayed.

approved_steps.step: 14. Click the Add button (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-35) on the Customer Service Inquiry screen.
approved_steps.expected: The Standard Order SO - Sales Order Header form opens for new order entry.

approved_steps.step: 15. Wait for 2 seconds for the Sales Order Header form to load.
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order Header form is fully loaded with all input fields visible.

approved_steps.step: 16. Click the Sold To field (Long Address Number, ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-71) on the Sales Order Header form.
approved_steps.expected: The Sold To (Long Address Number) field is focused and ready for input.

approved_steps.step: 17. Enter the Sold To value in the Sold To (Long Address Number) field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-71).
approved_steps.expected: The Sold To value is entered in the field.

approved_steps.step: 18. Press Tab to trigger field validation on the Sold To field.
approved_steps.expected: The system validates the Sold To value and may auto-populate related fields such as customer name.

approved_steps.step: 19. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sold To field validation to complete.
approved_steps.expected: The Sold To field validation is complete and related fields are populated.

approved_steps.step: 20. Click the Ship To field (Long Address Number-Shipto, ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-72) on the Sales Order Header form.
approved_steps.expected: The Ship To (Long Address Number-Shipto) field is focused and ready for input.

approved_steps.step: 21. Enter the Ship To value in the Ship To (Long Address Number-Shipto) field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-72).
approved_steps.expected: The Ship To value is entered in the field.

approved_steps.step: 22. Press Tab to trigger field validation on the Ship To field.
approved_steps.expected: The system validates the Ship To value and may auto-populate related address fields.

approved_steps.step: 23. Enter the Customer PO value in the Customer PO field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-74).
approved_steps.expected: The Customer PO value is entered in the Customer PO field.

approved_steps.step: 24. Wait for 5 seconds for the Customer PO field entry to be processed.
approved_steps.expected: The Customer PO value is accepted and the form is ready for submission.

approved_steps.step: 25. Click the OK button (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-26) on the Sales Order Header form.
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order Header is saved and the system proceeds to the next step or displays a confirmation dialog.

approved_steps.step: 26. Wait for 5 seconds for the system to process the Sales Order Header submission.
approved_steps.expected: The system processes the header and may display a confirmation or proceed to the detail entry screen.

approved_steps.step: 27. Click the OK button again (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-26) if a second confirmation dialog is presented.
approved_steps.expected: The second confirmation is accepted and the system proceeds to the Sales Order detail/line entry screen.

approved_steps.step: 28. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sales Order detail screen to load.
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order detail screen is displayed with the system-generated Sales Order Number visible in the Order Number field.

approved_steps.step: 29. Verify the system-generated Sales Order Number is displayed in the Order Number field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-57).
approved_steps.expected: A non-empty, system-generated Sales Order Number is visible in the Order Number field, confirming the order header was successfully created.

approved_steps.step: 30. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sales Order line entry section to be ready.
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order line entry area is fully loaded and ready for item entry.

approved_steps.step: 31. Enter the Item Number value in the Item Number field (ifr-e1menuAppIframe-el-122) on the Sales Order detail screen.
approved_steps.expected: The Item Number is entered in the Item Number field.

approved_steps.step: 32. Enter the Unit Price value in the Unit Price field on the Sales Order detail screen.
approved_steps.expected: The Unit Price is entered in the Unit Price field.
approved_steps.element_hint: Unit Price input field on Sales Order detail screen

approved_steps.step: 33. Click the OK button to save the Sales Order line item.
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order line item is saved and the system confirms the order creation with the Sales Order Number displayed.

approved_steps.step: 34. Wait for 5 seconds for the Sales Order to be fully saved.
approved_steps.expected: The Sales Order is fully saved. The system displays the completed Sales Order with the system-generated Order Number, confirming successful creation of the Standard Order SO.
